stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude Writes 80%+ of Its Own Production Code
stories.summary: Anthropic's June 4 paper "When AI Builds Itself" reveals Claude authored over 80% of merged production code in May 2026. Engineers now ship ~8x more code volume per day vs. 2024, with Anthropic internally estimating ~4x true productivity gain.
stories.why: This is the first major AI lab to publicly disclose that their AI is primarily writing their own production code — and simultaneously warn that recursive self-improvement could come sooner than most institutions are prepared for.

stories.headline: Anthropic Eclipses OpenAI in Valuation at ~$965B
stories.summary: Anthropic's Series H values it at ~$965B, surpassing OpenAI's ~$852B valuation. Annualized revenue hit $47B ARR (~$10.9B in Q2 2026), driven by enterprise Claude adoption.
stories.why: A new valuation leader has emerged in AI — faster than most expected. This reshapes the competitive narrative and signals that safety-focused labs can also win commercially.

stories.headline: Microsoft Launches MAI-Thinking-1 — Its First In-House Reasoning Model
stories.summary: MAI-Thinking-1 is a ~1 trillion parameter mixture-of-experts model with 35B active parameters and a 256K context window, purpose-built for reasoning and software engineering tasks.
stories.why: Microsoft's first proprietary reasoning model signals a strategic shift to reduce OpenAI dependency. Big Tech is now building frontier models, not just licensing them.

stories.headline: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash Goes Global Across All Surfaces
stories.summary: Released May 19, Gemini 3.5 Flash is now live across the Gemini app, Google Search AI Mode, Android Studio, AI Studio, the Antigravity 2.0 agent platform, and Gemini Enterprise.
stories.why: Google's broad rollout across consumer and developer surfaces signals it's competing hard on accessibility and ubiquity, not just benchmark performance.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches "Dreaming V3" — Persistent Memory Synthesis for ChatGPT
stories.summary: A background memory system that auto-updates time-sensitive memories and improves continuity over long time horizons, rolling out first to Plus and Pro users in the US.
stories.why: Persistent, evolving memory is a key step toward truly personal AI — assistants that improve with use rather than resetting each session.

stories.headline: DARPA + NSF Jointly Launch AI Forge R&D Program
stories.summary: A joint program to fund AI research with no immediate commercial applications, developed in collaboration with NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI).
stories.why: Government-funded foundational AI research fills a critical gap — areas with no short-term ROI but massive long-term strategic importance that private industry ignores.
